_comment: Maps Innovations supplier cost lists (dbo.PriceLists rows with PricelistGroup = 1) to the
supplier names used in catalog-rows.generated.json, so the cost-list conformance report can
suggest a cost for a missing grid cell.
This has to be hand-maintained: three vocabularies exist with no link between them —
PriceLists.PriceListName, dbo.Vendors.VendorName and dbo.Labs.Name — and Labs.POSupplierID is 0
on every row. Keyed by priceListId because names get edited (125 was 'CODEX TEST ACTIAN 20260720'
catalogueSupplier null means: no confident mapping. The report then shows the gap with no
suggested cost rather than guessing. Fill it in when someone confirms the pairing.
IMPORTANT: catalog-rows.generated.json costs are PER PAIR (see the 'per pair' comment in
lib/pricing-engine.js landedCostFor). Cost lists are PER EYE. The report halves catalogue costs
before suggesting them and shows both figures.
